column1: # Flight Radar partition table - carves out a `maps` partition for downloaded tiles.
# ESPHome's default 16MB layout gives app0/app1 0x7C0000 (7.75MB) each; with nvs
# that nearly fills the chip (~28KB left). Firmware is only ~3.2MB
# each app to 6MB still leaves nearly 2x headroom and frees space for the map.
# WARNING: partition table changes do NOT apply over OTA. Existing devices need
# a one-time USB reflash; OTA works again after that.
# maps: custom data subtype 0x82
#       sequential read via esp_partition_* (see map_tiles.h). 512KB; ~120KB used.
# WARNING: keep this order. otadata + phy_init = 0x3000 so app0 lands at 0x10000.
# ESPHome esp32/post_build.py.script hardcodes app at 0x10000 when using
# FLASH_EXTRA_IMAGES. If app0 moves (e.g. nvs before it -> 0x100000)
# overlaps sections and fails (exit 2); factory.bin is missing while the build
# still shows SUCCESS. Always append new partitions at the end.
# Name
otadata
phy_init
app0
app1
nvs
maps
